fee_notes: Royalty (Continuing License Fee) is tiered from 6.9% (weekly gross $0-$6,730) down to 3.9% (weekly gross $134,616+). Minimum weekly Continuing License Fees: none in months 1-6, $150/week in months 7-24, $200/week in months 25-48, $250/week month 49+. royalty_min_monthly approximated from $150/week x 4 = $600 for months 7-24. Technology Innovation Fund Fee is 0.25% of gross revenues (max 1%, capped at $15,000/franchisee/year). Marketing Fund Fee is 2% of gross revenues (may increase up to 0.5% per 2-year period). Software and Support Fee is $140/month plus $85/month per additional office. All weekly fees due each Wednesday for preceding week. Local Marketing Requirement: $2,500/month for first territory plus incremental amounts for additional territories.
raw_excerpt:
Continuing License Fees: 6.9% to 3.9% of Gross Revenues. Minimum Continuing License Fees may apply. Wednesday of each week for the preceding week. Gross Revenues is defined in Note 3 (see Notes 2, 3, 4 and 5)
Technology Innovation Fund Fee: 0.25% of Gross Revenues (see Notes 2 and 6). Wednesday of each week for the preceding week. The Technology Innovation Fund Fee you pay to us is deposited in The Maids® National Technology Fund
Marketing Fund Fee: 2% of Gross Revenues. Wednesday of each week for the preceding week. The Marketing Fund Fee you pay to us is deposited in The Maids® National Marketing Fund (see Notes 2 and 7)
Software and Support Fee (see Notes 1, 2): Currently $140 per month (Additional $85 per month per additional office). Subject to change with 30 days' notice. Monthly. Software and Support Fee will begin upon completion of SMART Start Training (see Note 8)
Weekly Gross Revenues tiers: $0-6,730: 6.9%; $6,731-13,460: 6.5%; $13,461-28,840: 6.0%; $28,841-48,070: 5.5%; $48,071-76,920: 5.0%; $76,921-134,615: 4.5%; $134,616 and up: 3.9%
Minimum Weekly Continuing License Fees: Months 1-6: No minimum; Months 7-24: $150; Months 25-48: $200; Months 49-thereafter: $250
